headline: Microsoft's Excel copy-paste fix widens from Excel 2016 to all Office users
summary: Microsoft fixed a copy-and-paste bug in Excel caused by its September 2026 security update. The first hotfix covered only Excel 2016 and, per one outlet, could still misbehave around conditional formatting. Days later, Microsoft shipped a broader fix covering all Office users.

claims.statement: A Microsoft hotfix addressed an Excel copy-and-paste bug from the September 2026 security update, initially for Excel 2016 only.

sources.quote: Microsoft fixes broken copy and paste for Excel 2016 users

claims.statement: Microsoft later fixed the same copy-and-paste bug for all Office users, not just Excel 2016.

sources.quote: Microsoft fixes broken Excel copy and paste for all Office users

discrepancies.explanation: theregister frames the first hotfix as incomplete while bleepingcomputer later reports the bug fully fixed for all users.

quotes.quote: may still come unstuck around conditional formatting
Microsoft fixes broken Excel copy and paste for all Office users
